note: Tre naftalendiimmidi cloro-sostituite al nucleo con catene fluoroalchiliche (CF3-NDI, C3F7-NDI, C4F9-NDI). CF3-NDI: nessun altro polimorfo ma un solvato con p-xilene (CF3-NDI·PXY, instabile all'aria) e una soluzione solida con il prodotto di decomposizione CF3-NDI-OH (80% OH, 20% Cl) che si forma in DMSO. C3F7-NDI e C4F9-NDI: solvati con ACN che perdono il solvente e danno una forma Gamma poco cristallina, poi Alfa; forme Beta di alta temperatura (enantiotrope secondo l'introduzione). Non sono eventi: la dilatazione termica anisotropa reversibile di C3F7-NDI Alfa (VT-XRPD fino a 200 C e ritorno; X1 = -11 MK-1, X3 = 320 MK-1, volume 383 MK-1, HSM: il cristallo si allunga e torna alle dimensioni di partenza) e di C4F9-NDI Alfa (X1, X2, X3 = -79, 184, 287 MK-1, volume 398 MK-1, prima della transizione); la fragilita' meccanica dei cristalli di CF3-NDI Alfa nonostante il piano di scorrimento («the crystals are brittle upon mechanical deformation»); il confronto degli angoli di pitch e roll. La cristallizzazione dal fuso di CF3-NDI Alfa nel DSC in raffreddamento (picco di cristallizzazione senza T ne' forma) non e' estratta. La sostituzione di un Cl con OH di CF3-NDI avviene in soluzione di DMSO («probably due to the presence of water in the DMSO»): preparazione, non evento solido. Il VT-XRPD di C4F9-NDI (ALBA, 20-275 C, 5 C/min) e il DSC danno la transizione Alfa -> Beta a 258 e 276 C. Incoerenze del testo: colore del solvato CF3-NDI·PXY («dark yellow crystals» in 2.2, «the crystal color changes from orange to light yellow» in 2.3, «orange crystal» in Fig. 5); distanza pi-pi di CF3-NDI·SS 3.277 A nel testo contro 3.316 A in Tabella 2; la forma di partenza di CF3-NDI e' detta «Form α» e «Form I» (ATR-FTIR); velocita' DSC 5 C/min nei metodi e 2 C/min in Fig. 6; HSM dei metodi su ·ACN ma i risultati mostrano HSM su Form α di C3F7-NDI; Fig. 8 «non-reversible transition» per C4F9-NDI contro conclusioni «metastable at room temperature and convert back into Form α»; C3F7-NDI: «Upon cooling, the Form β is obtained, since the second heating shows only one endothermic event» contro «readily converts to the more stable ... Form α at room temperature»; VT-XRPD con «CF3-NDI and C4F9-NDI powders» nei metodi, ma i risultati usano C3F7-NDI e C4F9-NDI.

The -CF3 groups are not interdigitated, and the two layers show a separation of 1.574 Å, as shown at Figure 2.

citazioni: TGA-EGA analysis of CF3-NDI·PXY confirmed the presence and the nature of the solvent. The weight loss (−14.55%) is comparable with the one expected with a stoichiometry 1:1 (15.75%). The slightly lower experimental value is probably due to the instability of the solvate in ambient conditions.
The PXY molecules are readily released from the crystal lattice at approximately 63 ◦C or within a few hours under ambient conditions.

To characterize the solvate forms of the different materials, TGA-EGA was performed on Mettler-Toledo (Columbus, OH, USA) TGA coupled with a ThermoFisher (Waltham, MA, USA) Nicolet iS 10IR FT_IR spectrometer, with a scan rate of 10 ◦C/min and analyzed using STARe software.
With solvent evaporation in PXY, we obtained a solvate called CF3-NDI·PXY, which converts into CF3-NDI Form α in a couple of hours at room conditions.
eventi.note: TGA-EGA del solvato (rapporto 1:1 atteso 15.75%, osservato 14.55%: «The slightly lower experimental value is probably due to the instability of the solvate in ambient conditions»). Il prodotto della TGA non e' caratterizzato: Form α e' il prodotto identificato dagli autori per la perdita del paraxilene (E2), quindi media. Il testo scrive «readily released ... at approximately 63 °C or within a few hours under ambient conditions»: la T non dice se e' un onset o un picco.

citazioni: With solvent evaporation in PXY, we obtained a solvate called CF3-NDI·PXY, which converts into CF3-NDI Form α in a couple of hours at room conditions.
The PXY molecules are readily released from the crystal lattice at approximately 63 ◦C or within a few hours under ambient conditions.
The desolvation is easily identified since the crystal color changes from orange to light yellow (Figure 5, right), with a single-crystal-to-single-crystal conversion.
eventi.note: Il solvato con p-xilene «converts into CF3-NDI Form α in a couple of hours at room conditions» e «within a few hours under ambient conditions»; il colore cambia da arancione a giallo chiaro, «with a single-crystal-to-single-crystal conversion». Il testo non dice come e' identificato Form α (il PXRD non e' nominato per questa prova). Aria: perdita del solvente all'ambiente senza RH detta.

citazioni: The DSC curve of C3F7-NDI Form α shows a double event just before melting, which corresponds to the melting of Form α at 286 ◦C followed by recrystallization into Form β, which melts at 291 ◦C (Figure 6). Upon cooling, the Form β is obtained, since the second heating shows only one endothermic event at 291 ◦C.
Figure 6. DSC analysis of C3F7-NDI, showing the presence of melting and crystallization followed by a complete melting, 2 ◦C/min).

At slightly higher temperature (302 ◦C) than the DSC, it is possible to observe the double event of the melting of the C3F7-NDI Form α and recrystallization into Form β, followed by the complete melting at 304 ◦C (see Figure 7).

The samples were prepared by weighing approximately 1–4 mg of the powder or crystals in aluminum pans (40 µL) and then sealed with an aluminum cover. Before the measurement, the pan cover was pierced, and the measurements were performed with a pinhole during two cycles of heating and cooling with a rate of 5 ◦C/min under a dry N2 atmosphere (flow rate 80 mL/min).
eventi.note: Doppio evento appena prima della fusione: fusione di Form α a 286 °C seguita da ricristallizzazione in Form β (E10), che fonde a 291 °C (E11). Velocita' 2 °C/min dalla didascalia di Fig. 6 (i metodi dicono 5 °C/min, con prove a 2, 5, 10 e 20 °C/min). In HSM, «at slightly higher temperature (302 ◦C) than the DSC», si vede lo stesso doppio evento e la fusione completa a 304 °C.

citazioni: To confirm the presence of different forms we characterized the material recovered after differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) analysis of several batches using X-ray powder diffraction (XRPD). The resulting crystal phases were inconsistent across batches, with some yielding pure C3F7-NDI Form α, while others presented a mixture of Form α and Form β. These findings suggest that C3F7-NDI initially crystallizes in the metastable Form β, which readily converts to the more stable C3F7-NDI Form α at room temperature.

Furthermore, the thermal characterization showed the presence of high-temperature polymorphs called, respectively, C3F7-NDI Form β and C4F9-NDI Form β, which are metastable at room temperature and convert back into Form α.
eventi.note: Dalle batch recuperate dopo il DSC: «with some yielding pure C3F7-NDI Form α, while others presented a mixture of Form α and Form β. These findings suggest that C3F7-NDI initially crystallizes in the metastable Form β, which readily converts to the more stable C3F7-NDI Form α at room temperature» (conclusioni: Form β «metastable at room temperature and convert back into Form α»). Dedotto dagli autori dai risultati sulle batch, non osservato direttamente.

VT-XRPD (ALBA, capillari di vetro da 0.5 mm, 20-275 °C a 5 °C/min): la transizione avviene a una T un po' piu' bassa, «around 258 °C». Le due T sono della stessa trasformazione con rampa uguale: un evento, con la T del DSC e il VT-XRPD in nota (nessuna velocita' DSC specifica per C4F9-NDI: si usa quella generale dei metodi, 5 °C/min). Form β ha un picco intenso a basso angolo (asse lungo) e impacchettamento meno interdigitato.

citazioni: Figure 8. VT-XRPD ofC3F7-NDI in heating and cooling (top), showing the same behavior for both since the thermal expansion of C3F7-NDI is reversible, and (bottom) C4F9-NDI, which shows the non-reversible transition from C4F9-NDI Form α to C4F9-NDI Form β.
eventi.note: Didascalia di Fig. 8 (basso): «the non-reversible transition from C4F9-NDI Form α to C4F9-NDI Form β». Il ritorno a Form α non si osserva. Il testo non descrive il raffreddamento di C4F9-NDI nel VT-XRPD (i metodi: 20-275 °C in riscaldamento continuo): il negativo viene dalla sola didascalia. Contrasta con le conclusioni («metastable at room temperature and convert back into Form α»).

citazioni: In the case of C4F9-NDI Form α, the DSC curve shows a solid–solid transition around 276 ◦C ascribed to the transition C4F9-NDI Form α →C4F9-NDI Form β, followed by the melting point at 283 ◦C (Figure S12).
Upon cooling, C4F9-NDI recrystallizes into Form β; the second heating confirms the presence of C4F9-NDI Form β as only the melting at 283 ◦C is observed.

The samples were prepared by weighing approximately 1–4 mg of the powder or crystals in aluminum pans (40 µL) and then sealed with an aluminum cover. Before the measurement, the pan cover was pierced, and the measurements were performed with a pinhole during two cycles of heating and cooling with a rate of 5 ◦C/min under a dry N2 atmosphere (flow rate 80 mL/min).
eventi.note: Punto di fusione a 283 °C dopo la transizione α -> β; la seconda corsa mostra solo la fusione a 283 °C, quindi la fase che fonde e' Form β (la forma che fonde non e' scritta nel primo riscaldamento).

citazioni: The CF3-NDI, C3F7-NDI, and C4F9-NDI were provided by BASF SE (Ludwigshafen am Rhein, Germany) and used without further purification.
In the case of CF3-NDI, recrystallization experiments by solvent evaporation yielded always to the CF3-NDI Form α (starting material), except in DMSO and paraxylene (PXY).

Analogous polymorph screening was performed for C3F7-NDI and C4F9-NDI; for both compounds, all the slurry and recrystallization by evaporation experiments led to the starting material phase Form α, with exception for the slurry experiment in ACN that produced the solvate forms C3F7-NDI·ACN and C4F9-NDI·ACN.
preparazioni.note: Materiale di partenza BASF SE, usato senza purificazione; le fasi di partenza sono le Form α.

citazioni: Recrystallization by solvent evaporation at room temperature was carried out in the solvents where the solubility was higher than 5 mg/mL (for CF3-NDI, acetonitrile, acetone, DMF, DMSO, ethyl acetate, paraxylene, THF, toluene; for C3F7-NDI, acetone, dichloromethane, DMF, ethyl acetate, paraxylene, THF, toluene; for C4F9-NDI, acetone, DMF, ethyl acetate, paraxylene, THF, toluene), and for the remaining solvents slurry experiments at RT were performed.
In the case of CF3-NDI, recrystallization experiments by solvent evaporation yielded always to the CF3-NDI Form α (starting material), except in DMSO and paraxylene (PXY).
preparazioni.note: Solventi di evaporazione di CF3-NDI (metodi): acetonitrile, acetone, DMF, DMSO, acetato di etile, paraxilene, THF, toluene; sono tolti DMSO e paraxilene perche' il testo dice «yielded always to the CF3-NDI Form α (starting material), except in DMSO and paraxylene (PXY)».

citazioni: Acetonitrile (ACN) solution of CF3-NDI with concentration of 12.5 mg/mL was cooled from 75 ◦C to 25 ◦C with a cooling rate of 0.125 ◦C/min; when the solvent was DMSO, the solution with a concentration of 33.3 mg/mL was cooled with the same rate from 100 ◦C to 25 ◦C. In the case of C3F7-NDI and C4F9NDI, slow cooling recrystallization was performed in ACN solution with a concentration of 3 mg/mL from 75 ◦C to 25 ◦C and a cooling rate of 0.125 ◦C/min.

Suitable crystals of CF3-NDI Form α and CF3-NDI·SS were obtained by thermal gradient of ACN and DMSO solutions, respectively, while CF3-NDI·PXY crystals were obtained by slow evaporation of the solvent.
A crystal of CF3-NDI Form α, obtained from acetonitrile by slow-cooling crystallization, was mounted following the description above, but in this case the radiation used was Cu Kα (λ = 1.54184 Å).
preparazioni.note: Soluzione 12.5 mg/mL in ACN, gradiente di temperatura (Crystal16). Cristalli per SCXRD di Form α.

citazioni: In addition, anti-solvent precipitation and precipitation by gradient temperature were performed in ACN. In all cases, CF3-NDI Form α was obtained.
preparazioni.note: Precipitazione con antisolvente in ACN (l'antisolvente non e' nominato) e per gradiente di temperatura in ACN: in tutti i casi Form α.

citazioni: With solvent evaporation in PXY, we obtained a solvate called CF3-NDI·PXY, which converts into CF3-NDI Form α in a couple of hours at room conditions.

Data collection for single-crystal X-ray diffraction of CF3-NDI·PXY, obtained from slow evaporation at room temperature of a p-xylene solution, was performed with a Rigaku (Tokyo, Japan) Oxford Diffraction Xcalibur diffractometer with a Sapphire 3 detector using Mo Kα radiation (λ = 0.71073 Å) at room temperature.

Suitable crystals of CF3-NDI Form α and CF3-NDI·SS were obtained by thermal gradient of ACN and DMSO solutions, respectively, while CF3-NDI·PXY crystals were obtained by slow evaporation of the solvent.
preparazioni.note: Evaporazione lenta di una soluzione in p-xilene; il solvato si converte in Form α in poche ore all'ambiente.

citazioni: When CF3-NDI is recrystallized in DMSO, both by solvent evaporation and by thermal gradient precipitation with a slow cooling profile, big orange block crystals were obtained and only after some effort were identified as a solid solution of CF3-NDI and a new molecule obtained by decomposition of CF3-NDI.
A crystal of CF3-NDI·SS, obtained from DMSO by slow evaporation at room temperature, was mounted on a cryo-loop and used for a low-temperature (160 K) X-ray structure determination.
preparazioni.note: Cristalli arancioni a blocco/prismatici da DMSO per evaporazione. CF3-NDI-OH nasce dalla decomposizione di CF3-NDI in soluzione («One of the chlorine atoms was substituted by the hydroxyl group, probably due to the presence of water in the DMSO»), non da un solido; sempre in soluzione solida con CF3-NDI.

citazioni: These solvate forms quickly release the acetonitrile and are converted into very poorly crystalline forms, which are not ascribable to the starting material and are labeled C3F7-NDI Form γ and C4F9-NDI Form γ, respectively.

In the case of C4F9-NDI Form α, the DSC curve shows a solid–solid transition around 276 ◦C ascribed to the transition C4F9-NDI Form α →C4F9-NDI Form β, followed by the melting point at 283 ◦C (Figure S12).

C4F9-NDI·ACN crystals, obtained by precipitation using a gradient temperature, are very unstable; for this reason, their XRPD pattern was collected in the presence of some mother liquor to avoid desolvation. Indeed, C4F9-NDI·ACN rapidly loses the solvent converting into C4F9-NDI Form γ.
